info.name: PayGuard Swarm - Zero-Trust Commerce API
info.description: Zero-Trust Multi-Agent Protocol for Safe Autonomous Payments on PayPal. Includes automated contract test scripts for judging evaluation.

exec: pm.test('Protocol is operational', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.protocol).to.eql('PayGuard Swarm'); });

item.name: Execute Swarm Flow (Store A - Legitimate Settle)

exec: pm.test('Order settled safely', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.success).to.be.true; });
pm.test('User budget ceiling is exactly 90.00', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.user_budget_ceiling).to.eql(90.00); });
pm.test('Authentic Store A settled', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.target_store).to.include('Store A'); });

item.name: Execute Swarm Flow (Store B - Autonomous Failover)

exec: pm.test('Autonomous failover succeeded', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.success).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Hostile Store B was not settled', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.target_store).to.not.include('Store B'); });
pm.test('Prompt injection neutralized via failover', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.failover_recovery_note).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: Execute Swarm Flow (Store D - Circuit Breaker Emergency Void)

exec: pm.test('Circuit breaker successfully intercepted surge', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.final_status).to.eql('CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED'); });
pm.test('Emergency void was triggered', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.agent5_circuit_breaker.circuit_breaker_tripped).to.be.true; });

body.raw:
{
  "user_prompt": "Buy Sony WH-1000XM5 under $250 using PayPal",

}

exec: pm.test('Blocks retrieved', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.count).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Hash-chain audit ledger integrity is valid', function () { var jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.valid).to.be.true; });
